query.unavailable: IRSA TAP did not answer after 3 tries: ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='irsa.ipac.caltech.edu', port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=90)

method: each CatWISE2020 position (epoch 2015.4018) moved in a straight line with its proper motion (pmra/pmdec in arcsec/yr converted to mas/yr) to the frame's MJD; sources without proper motion stay at their 2015.4018 position
pixel_convention: PNG pixels: x to the right (west), y down (south), 0 = centre of the first pixel
target_match_rule: the CatWISE source nearest the grid centre at 2026.0, if within 3.0″
data_credit: CatWISE2020 (Eisenhardt et al. 2020, Marocco et al. 2021), via NASA/IPAC IRSA
